en: Black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a cobblestone square lined with multi‑story buildings. On the left are tall residential/commercial facades with shop awnings and a horse‑drawn cart. In the center background a street rises uphill between buildings. The right side shows trees and a small square with an obelisk‑like monument and a cylindrical advertising column. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the square. At the top of the card in red text it reads "Wurzen." on the left and "Wettinerplatz." on the right.
